replies.text: It's a typical claim by uninformed people that there's 'only one lake in the lake district' - They try to justify it by claiming that 'water' 'mere' and 'lake' are all specific and scientific definitions of various areas of water - They're not - they're just different names for various areas of water. So if 'water' and 'mere' mean two different things in geographical terms - what the hell happened there?
